theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbs_testForm_countable_approx
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → ∃ D : Set (TestFormOn U n), D.Countable ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, ∃ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn U n), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K ∧ (∀ k, ωs k ∈ D) ∧ (∀ k, tsupport (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k x => (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) atTop ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k x => exteriorDerivative (ωs k : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) atTop
